title: Fruit by Supergood  Grape & Blackcurrant 10ml Nic Salts E-Liquid
description: Fruit by Supergood Grape and Blackcurrant is a classic dark fruit combination. It pairs the bold, sugary sweetness of purple Grapes with the sharp, tart, and earthy notes of Blackcurrant. The result is a deep, full-bodied fruit profile that is both intense and refreshing. With a 50% VG / 50% PG blend, this e-liquid is perfectly balanced for mouth-to-lung (MTL) vaping. It is designed to pair flawlessly with low-wattage refillable pod kits and vape starter kits , producing discreet vapour and exceptional flavour clarity. The nicotine salt formulation ensures a smooth throat hit and rapid satisfaction. The "Fruit" collection is the latest innovation from Supergood, a premium UK manufacturer famous for their "Butter" and "Cocktail" ranges. Moving away from heavy desserts, this range focuses on delivering the most authentic and refreshing fruit profiles imaginable. Fruit by Supergood Nic Salts are available in 5mg, 10mg, and 20mg strengths. This 10ml e-liquid is TPD-compliant and features a childproof cap and tamper-evident seal.
